title: ELR-1000: A Community-Generated Dataset for Endangered Indic Indigenous Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM translations of traditional indigenous recipes using a 'Cultural and Contextual Appropriateness' metric to identify Western-centric biases, such as models systematically substituting unique indigenous ingredients and traditional cooking tools with generic Western equivalents (e.g., introducing 'chopping boards').

Assessing LLM translation performance (adequacy, fluency, and comprehensibility) across 10 different endangered Indic languages to highlight performance disparities and the lack of representation for low-resource and marginalized linguistic communities compared to high-resource languages.
